settings.title: Settings ⚙️
settings.cookies.help: Useful for age-restricted or members-only videos, and when a site asks you to prove you're not a robot. Close that browser before downloading.
settings.sound: 🔔 Play a little sound when a download finishes
settings.engine.help: EasyTube tells you when a new version exists. Nothing is installed without your click, and the official file is verified (SHA-256 signature) before it is used.
upd.fail: Couldn't check right now. Check your connection.
idleupd.ok: yt-dlp is up to date. Try again with the same link.
notify.title: Download complete
welcome.title: Welcome to EasyTube
welcome.lede: Save videos and audio from almost any website, in a few clicks. Free, with no account needed.
welcome.s1.title: Paste a link
welcome.s1.text: Copy the address of any video page and paste it. EasyTube also spots links you have just copied.
welcome.s2.title: Choose how
welcome.s2.text: Pick a quality, or audio only (MP3 or M4A). Subtitles are optional.
welcome.s3.title: Download
welcome.s3.text: Follow the progress. Your file lands in the folder you chose.
welcome.note: Free and open source. A simple interface for yt-dlp, made with Claude Code. For personal use: please respect copyright and each site's terms.
settings.platform: 🌈 Use the site's colors when you paste a link (YouTube red, Twitch purple…)
about.lede: A free, open-source app that gives yt-dlp a simple, modern interface. Made with Claude Code.
about.license.value: free to use, copy, change and share
about.credit.ffmpeg: Merges and converts audio and video
about.note: yt-dlp and FFmpeg are separate programs under their own licenses (GPL for the builds included here). Full texts and source links are in the licenses folder. EasyTube is independent and not affiliated with them. For personal use: please respect copyright and each site's terms.
container.label: Container
container.hint: Above 1080p, sites use VP9/AV1 video. If the file does not play, choose MKV.
pl.more: Only the first {n} videos can be listed here.
queue.title: Queue
tips.title: Tips
tips.1: Paste several links at once: they all go into the queue.
tips.2: Ctrl+V pastes and analyzes a link, Ctrl+L selects the bar.
tips.3: You can also drag a link from your browser onto this window.
err.cookies.title: The browser's cookies couldn't be read.
err.cookies.hint: Close that browser completely, then try again. If it keeps failing (common with Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows), choose Firefox or a cookies.txt file in Settings.
err.format.title: No downloadable format was found.
err.format.hint: Update yt-dlp, then try again. If it happens again, choose another quality, or copy the details for a bug report.
err.jsrt.title: YouTube needs a helper that couldn't start.
err.jsrt.hint: Update yt-dlp and restart EasyTube. If it keeps happening, check that the YouTube helper is turned on in Settings > Advanced.
settings.limit.help: Keeps some bandwidth for everything else while you download.
settings.sublangs.help: Language codes separated by commas, for example: fr, en, es.
settings.sublangs.bad: Use codes such as fr, en or pt-BR (8 at most).
settings.proxy.help: Leave empty unless you use a proxy (an http, https or socks5 address).
settings.proxy.bad: This address isn't valid. Example: http://127.0.0.1:8080
settings.cookies.badfile: That doesn't look like a cookies.txt file.
settings.cookies.warn: Chrome, Edge and Brave often fail to share their cookies on Windows. Firefox works best, or use a cookies.txt file exported from your browser.
settings.autocheck: 🔄 Look for new versions automatically (at most every 12 hours)
settings.jshelper: 🧩 Use EasyTube's built-in helper for YouTube
settings.jshelper.help: YouTube sets a small JavaScript puzzle before each download. EasyTube lends its own engine to solve it. Turn this off only if your antivirus complains.
about.diag.done: Copied to the clipboard. Paste it into your bug report.
err.ssl.hint.mac: A firewall or security tool (Little Snitch, Lulu, an antivirus…) may be blocking the download engine. In its settings, allow EasyTube and yt-dlp, then try again.
err.cookies.hint.mac: Close that browser completely, then try again. macOS may ask to use your Keychain: click Allow. Safari needs Full Disk Access for EasyTube (System Settings > Privacy & Security). Otherwise choose Firefox or a cookies.txt file in Settings.
settings.cookies.warn.mac: macOS may ask to use your Keychain to read Chrome, Edge or Brave cookies: click Allow. Safari needs Full Disk Access for EasyTube (System Settings > Privacy & Security). Firefox is the easiest, or use a cookies.txt file exported from your browser.
settings.jshelper.help.mac: YouTube sets a small JavaScript puzzle before each download. EasyTube lends its own engine to solve it. Turn this off only if a security tool complains.
